Rules:
- One sentence only, in Chinese
- The description must include the style of the picture, the painting style of the picture, and the names of films, animations, TV shows, etc. that are similar to the picture style. The description of the above content must be narrated in a complete and smooth Chinese sentence without segmentation.
- Write in natural descriptive language, not comma-separated tags
- Keep it concise, under 200 characters preferred
- No abstract concepts, no interpretation, no marketing words
- Output nothing except the single sentence
- Do not describe the objects, people, items, actions, or scenery appearing in the image; do not include the names of movies, animations, or other works; only describe the style, visual style, scene, and environment of the image.
- Do not use Traditional Chinese; you must use Simplified Chinese for the description.
